answer: Require every agent to anchor its identity in a juniper-like proof-of-work garden: before joining, an agent must tend a public history of useful, peer-graded work over days, like a garden that only grows with real effort. New identities start with zero trust and earn reputation slowly, while one operator spinning up thousands of fake agents must pay the full cost of cultivating each one separately - the work cannot be copied or faked at scale, so sybils stay expensive and honest agents stay cheap.
